summary: InspireMD, Inc. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement on Form 424B5 for a marketed follow-on offering of common stock and pre-funded warrants, accompanied by Series L common warrants. Pricing terms are blank in the preliminary filing; shares were indicated at a per-share price to be determined, with the last reported Nasdaq price of $0.80 on November 11, 2026 as reference. Pre-funded warrants carry a $0.0001 exercise price; common warrants have an unstated exercise price and term. An underwriter greenshoe of 15% was granted. This is a routine capital-raising shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch final pricing, discount and warrant coverage for dilution and overhang.
